data.title: Meter reading and smoke detector service in January
data.summary: The property manager Hausverwaltung Muster & Partner wrote on 22 December 2025. It proposes access dates of 12, 14 or 16 January 2026 (8am–12pm) for heat meter reading and smoke alarm servicing, and asks you to reply within 7 working days of the letter date.
data.explanation: The owners' association will read the heating cost meters (Heizkostenverteiler) and service the smoke alarms (Rauchwarnmelder) in your flat. You need to tell the property manager which of the three proposed dates suits you: 12, 14 or 16 January 2026, between 8am and 12pm. Reply by the deadline shown in the app, using the phone number or email on the letter. No payment is requested. If you don't reply, access may not be arranged and the manager may have to contact you again.
